arguments.summary: Decision frame: assess NVDA and MU at the 2026-10-04 report time over 5/21/63 completed-session horizons, separating issuer operating durability and stipulated EPS/P-E sensitivities from observed price behavior and policy/supply risks. All five specialist roles are already assigned; this plan does not create duplicate work.

claims.text: The assessment market is closed; the relevant completed-session date for both NVDA and MU is 2026-10-02, while the snapshot observations are single-venue IEX and not consolidated executable quotes.

The research plan can use dated annual reported diluted EPS anchors and completed-session prices for each company, but must retain the stated share-basis and no-consensus qualifications when constructing sensitivities.

gaps.description: No final specialist research or reconciled deterministic bear/base/bull valuation grids are yet available in this planning stage; no directional or relative-preference conclusion should be made until the assigned Company, Macro, Technical, Geopolitics, Commodities, and Challenger work is reconciled.

assumptions: Company will deliver one deterministic bear/base/bull EPS-P/E sensitivity grid per issuer, explicitly distinguishing reported fiscal periods, interim earnings, guidance and scenario assumptions.
Macro will assess rates, dollar and broad risk-appetite transmission rather than treat ETF proxies as causal macro evidence.
Technical will use completed-session return windows, relative strength versus SPY/XLK, volatility and path risk without forecasting from them.
Geopolitics will distinguish dated export-control facts from unquantified issuer exposure and policy scenarios.
Commodities will assess only evidenced input, pricing or capacity channels; it will not infer company exposure from USO alone.
Final synthesis will reconcile the completed Challenger work and all five specialists, preserve contradictions, and use human-review conditions for unresolved multi-factor changes.
arguments.counter_thesis: Strong recent semiconductor operating results or price momentum could be overtaken by multiple compression, memory-cycle reversal, export restrictions, supply disruption, rates/dollar pressure, or risk-off market behavior; the plan therefore requires independent operating, macro, technical, policy and commodity review before any preference.

review_conditions.description: Reassess both companies after the assigned specialists establish whether new reported guidance, export-policy implementation, supply/capacity evidence, or completed-session relative-strength reversal changes the operating-to-valuation bridge or the comparison.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Both are semiconductor companies exposed to changes in advanced-computing trade restrictions and to broad technology/risk-market conditions; the available dated policy text does not quantify either issuer's exposure or establish the complete current regime.
shared_exposures.qualification: Shared exposure is a candidate transmission channel, not a quantified revenue, earnings, or portfolio-weight assertion.

agent_report.work_summary: Defined the decision frame and integration plan using the supplied completed-close, issuer-EPS, live-time and dated-policy evidence. I reviewed role status and deliberately made no duplicate assignments because all five specialist roles are already assigned by the controller.
main_conclusions: Use 2026-10-02 completed closes for market-behavior comparisons; IEX observations are not executable consolidated quotes.
Do not make a stock ranking at planning stage.
Final judgment must combine the five assigned specialist reports with the completed Challenger review and deterministic company sensitivity grids.
agent_report.short_summary: This is a research plan, not a directional conclusion. It reserves preference judgment until the already-assigned specialist work is reconciled.
limitations: No specialist findings or final scenario grids were available in this stage.
The dated policy source is not certification of subsequent amendments or quantified company impact.
